import os

program.js:
const f = std.open('/data/tmp', 'w')
f.puts('payload')
f.flush()
os.rename('/data/tmp', '/data/final')
f.puts('+more')
f.close()
console.log(JSON.stringify(os.readdir('/data')[0].filter((n) => n[0] !== '.').sort()), std.open('/data/final', 'r').readAsString())
const g = std.open('/data/h.txt', 'r+')
os.remove('/data/h.txt')
console.log(g.readAsString())
g.puts('X')
g.close()
console.log(os.stat('/data/h.txt')[1])
program.node:
const fs = require('node:fs').promises
const f = await fs.open('/data/tmp', 'w')
await f.write('payload')
await fs.rename('/data/tmp', '/data/final')
await f.write('+more')
await f.close()
console.log(JSON.stringify((await fs.readdir('/data')).sort()), await fs.readFile('/data/final', 'utf8'))
const g = await fs.open('/data/h.txt', 'r+')
await fs.unlink('/data/h.txt')
console.log((await g.read(Buffer.alloc(10), 0, 10, 0)).bytesRead)
await g.write('X')
await g.close()
console.log(await fs.access('/data/h.txt').then(() => true, () => false))
